crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin slips back under $60,000
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC fell below $60K again overnight as ETH dropped under $1,700, giving back Monday's bounce.

crypto_headlines.title: $850M in leveraged liquidations in 24 hours
crypto_headlines.summary: The whipsaw around $60K wiped out about $850 million in levered positions in a day.

crypto_headlines.title: CFTC lets regulated venues count BTC, ETH and stablecoins
crypto_headlines.summary: CFTC staff guidance lets regulated exchanges and clearinghouses use Bitcoin, Ethereum and qualifying stablecoins toward certain financial requirements, after haircuts.

crypto_headlines.title: BTCS sells 27,300 ETH to repay Aave debt
crypto_headlines.summary: The Nasdaq-listed firm sold about 27,300 ETH for $43.8 million during Friday's selloff to cut its Aave borrowings and liquidation risk.

crypto_headlines.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX trade tokenized gold
crypto_headlines.summary: The banks completed the first live trades in tokenized fractional gold, letting physical bars be used as collateral without moving the metal.

crypto_headlines.title: Swiss National Bank and UBS explore tokenized settlement
crypto_headlines.summary: The SNB, UBS, SIX and six others are exploring tokenized financial settlement under Project Helvetia.

doginal_news.title: DDMIAMI 2026 is two weeks out
doginal_news.summary: Doginal Dogs announced DDMIAMI 2026 is in two weeks: "The Dogs are about to take on Vice City."

doginal_news.title: First DDLTCG Championship Swiss rounds keep rolling
doginal_news.summary: The first Legends TCG Championship is in its Swiss rounds, with 13 days to go until DD Miami.

doginal_news.title: Pyth priced 91.6% of October commodity perps
doginal_news.summary: Commodity perps did $206B in volume in October, and Pyth priced 91.6% of it.

doginal_news.title: Former Nasdaq compliance head Nick Carso joins
doginal_news.summary: After 20+ years at Nasdaq, Nick Carso joins the network as Head of Data Solutions.

doginal_news.title: Kalshi reportedly settled 387.3M contracts on Pyth-priced markets
doginal_news.summary: Kalshi reportedly processed 387.3M contracts from Nov 16 to 22 on markets settled with Pyth price feeds, and Pyth shared the stat.

notes: No original posts from @doginaldogs or @DDLTCG in the last 24 hours beyond the DDMIAMI countdown; the Championship update comes from the community.
